title: 「It is said / reported / believed that + clause」
titleZh: 「It is said / reported / believed that + 子句」轉述消息
titleEn: Passive reporting with “It is said / reported / believed that”

source.file: Sentence Structure 270 -「It is said _ reported _ believed that + clause」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 270; it is assigned system ID ss271 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: It + be + reporting past participle + that + complete clause

formulas.formula: It is + reporting past participle + that + clause
It was + reporting past participle + that + clause
It has been + reporting past participle + that + clause
Introductory phrase / clause + it + be + reporting past participle + that + clause

example: It is reported that the meeting has been cancelled.

examples.en: It is reported that the meeting has been cancelled.
examples.highlight: It is reported that the meeting has been cancelled.

meaning.zh: 這個句型轉述人們所說、新聞或報告所提供、普遍相信、估計、宣佈或證實的消息，把重點放在消息本身而非消息提出者。

rules.zh: 核心句型不包括時間、地點或副詞 核心句型是： It + be + past participle + that + clause 例如： It is believed that the plan will work. 以下成分只是可選的延伸： ● widely ● generally ● commonly ● officially ● recently ● now ● in the village ● according to the report ● after the investigation Examples: It is widely believed that the plan will work. After the investigation, it was believed that the fire had started accidentally. The additional words explain where, when or how widely the information is accepted. They are not part of the fixed core structure. 這些額外成分只是說明消息的時間、來源或普及程度，並不屬於固定核心句型。
rules.en: The fixed core is It + be + past participle + that + clause. Time, place, source and adverbs such as widely or recently are optional extensions.

rules.zh: 是形式主語 這裏的 it 並不代表某件物件、動物或人物。 It is reported that the road is closed. 真正的重要內容是： that the road is closed 使用形式主語 it，可以把較長的消息內容放在句子後半部。
rules.en: It is a formal subject here; the real information is carried by the complete that-clause that follows.

rules.zh: 必須使用過去分詞 Correct: It is believed that the building is safe. Incorrect: It is believe that the building is safe. 常見過去分詞包括： ● say → said ● report → reported ● believe → believed ● think → thought ● know → known ● expect → expected ● claim → claimed ● allege → alleged ● estimate → estimated ● announce → announced ● confirm → confirmed ● predict → predicted ● understand → understood ● suggest → suggested ● establish → established ● acknowledge → acknowledged
rules.en: Use the reporting verb's past participle, such as said, reported, believed, known, expected, claimed, alleged, estimated, announced or confirmed.

rules.zh: 動詞顯示消息是在甚麼時候提出的 Present reporting It is believed that the tunnel is safe. （目前一般相信隧道是安全的。） Past reporting It was believed that the tunnel was safe. （當時一般相信隧道是安全的。） Recent report with present relevance It has been reported that the tunnel will reopen soon. （近日有報道指隧道即將重開。） is、was 和 has been 並非可以隨意交換。答案必須保留原句的時間意思。
rules.en: Choose the form of be to preserve reporting time: is for a current report, was for a past report, and has been for a recent report with present relevance.

rules.zh: 後面必須是完整子句 Correct: It is reported that the train has arrived. that 後面有： ● subject: the train ● verb: has arrived Incorrect: It is reported that the arrival of the train. the arrival of the train 是名詞短語，不是完整子句。 本練習所有答案均須保留 that。
rules.en: That must be followed by a complete clause with its own subject and verb, not merely a noun phrase. Retain that throughout this exercise.

rules.zh: 不同報道動詞表達不同程度的肯定 said 表示有人這樣說，但沒有說明消息是否已證實。 It is said that the house is haunted. （據說這所房子鬧鬼。） reported 表示有新聞、報告或消息來源這樣報道。 It is reported that the road has reopened. （據報道路已經重開。） believed / thought 表示一般看法或判斷。 It is believed that the painting is genuine. （一般相信這幅畫是真品。） known 表示事情被視為已知事實。 It is known that regular exercise benefits health. （眾所周知，恆常運動有益健康。） expected / predicted 表示對將來的預期或預測。 It is expected that prices will rise. （預計價格將會上升。） claimed / alleged 表示有人提出說法，但該說法未必已獲證實。 It is alleged that the official accepted money illegally. （有人指稱該名官員非法收受金錢。） 使用 claimed 或 alleged 並不代表說法一定真實。 estimated 表示數字、數量、成本或時間只是約數。 It is estimated that the repairs will cost £2 million. （估計維修工程將耗資二百萬英鎊。） announced / confirmed 表示消息已正式公布或證實。 It has been confirmed that the event will proceed. （現已證實活動將如期舉行。）
rules.en: Choose the reporting participle carefully because said, reported, believed, known, expected, claimed, alleged, estimated, announced and confirmed express different sources or degrees of certainty.

rules.zh: 與 “Subject is believed to…” 的分 別 這兩個句型通常可以表達相近意思。 It is believed that the cave is 2,000 years old. The cave is believed to be 2,000 years old. 第一句使用形式主語 it，然後以 that 子句提供完整消息。 第二句把消息中的主體 the cave 放在句首，後面使用不定式。 Simple or present action The artist is said to live in Paris. It is said that the artist lives in Paris. Continuing action The artist is said to be working in Paris. It is said that the artist is working in Paris. Earlier action The artist is said to have left Paris. It is said that the artist has left Paris. Earlier action viewed from a past reporting time The team was said to have left before dawn. It was said that the team had left before dawn. Future expectation The storm is expected to reach the coast tonight. It is expected that the storm will reach the coast tonight.
rules.en: The it + passive + that-clause pattern and the subject + passive + to-infinitive pattern can express similar meanings, but their grammar differs.

rules.zh: 不可混合兩種句型 Incorrect: The meeting is reported that it has been cancelled. Correct: It is reported that the meeting has been cancelled. Also correct: The meeting is reported to have been cancelled. 本練習要求使用第一種： It is reported that + clause
rules.en: Do not mix the two reporting patterns. Write either “It is reported that the meeting has been cancelled” or “The meeting is reported to have been cancelled.”

rules.zh: 報道句型不一定要放在整句的第一個位置 The core structure can follow a time, place, source or linking clause. After a time phrase Yesterday, it was reported that the road had reopened. After a source phrase According to the latest forecast, it is predicted that temperatures will rise. After a dependent clause Although no official statement has been released, it is reported that the minister will resign. After another main clause The tests are now complete, and it has been confirmed that the system is safe. 這些變化能令句子更自然，也避免所有答案都以完全相同的方式開始。
rules.en: The reporting structure can follow a time, place, source, linking phrase or dependent clause; it does not have to begin the complete sentence.

rules.zh: 注意否定的位置 It is not believed that the plan will succeed. （人們不相信計劃會成功。） It is believed that the plan will not succeed. （人們相信計劃不會成功。） 兩句意思相近，但重點不同： ● 第一種否定 believing； ● 第二種否定 succeeding。 改寫時不可隨意移動 not。 Best Core Grammar Bank 核心句型庫 1. Present reporting It is said / reported / believed that + clause It is believed that the building is safe. （一般相信該建築物是安全的。） 2. Past reporting It was said / reported / believed that + clause It was reported that the flight had been delayed. （當時有報道指航班已經延誤。） 3. Present perfect reporting It has been said / reported / confirmed that + clause It has been confirmed that the event will proceed. （現已證實活動將如期舉行。） 4. With an optional adverb It is widely / generally / commonly believed that + clause It is widely believed that sleep supports memory. （人們普遍相信睡眠有助記憶。） 5. After a time, place or source phrase Introductory phrase + it + be + past participle + that + clause According to the latest forecast, it is predicted that temperatures will rise. （根據最新預測，氣溫預計將會上升。） 6. After another clause Clause + and / but + it + be + past participle + that + clause The investigation continues, but it is reported that no evidence has been found. （調查仍在繼續，但據報尚未發現任何證據。） 7. From a subject-raising structure Subject + be + past participle + to-infinitive → It + be + past participle + that + subject + verb The singer is said to be recording a new album. → It is said that the singer is recording a new album.
rules.en: Keep negation in its intended position. “It is not believed that ...” negates the belief, whereas “It is believed that ... not ...” places the negative meaning inside the reported information.

benefits.zh: 把重點放在消息本身 有時候，誰提出消息並不重要、不清楚，或沒有必要說明。 Instead of: People report that the road has reopened. You can write: It is reported that the road has reopened. 讀者會直接把注意力放在道路重開這項消息上。
benefits.en: It focuses attention on the information itself when the person or group presenting it is unimportant, unknown or unnecessary.

benefits.zh: 避免反覆使用含糊的主語 初學者經常重複使用： ● people say; ● they believe; ● everyone thinks; ● someone reported. 這個句型可以省略不重要或不明確的說話者。 People believe that the treatment is safe. It is believed that the treatment is safe.
benefits.en: It avoids repeated vague subjects such as people, they, everyone or someone.

benefits.zh: 顯示消息有多可靠 你可以選擇不同動詞，向讀者表明消息的性質： ● known：被視為事實； ● confirmed：已證實； ● believed：一般相信； ● reported：有人報道； ● claimed：有人聲稱； ● alleged：有人指稱，但未經證實； ● rumoured：只是傳聞； ● estimated：只是估計。 這能幫助你避免把未經證實的消息寫成事實。
benefits.en: It shows the status and certainty of the information through a carefully chosen reporting verb.

benefits.zh: 適合報告、文章和簡報 這個句型常用來介紹： ● 調查結果； ● 新聞消息； ● 專家看法； ● 普遍觀點； ● 統計估計； ● 正式公布； ● 未經證實的指控。 它能令語氣更客觀，不必每次都以 I think 或 people say 開始。
benefits.en: It is useful in reports, essays and presentations about findings, news, expert views, estimates, announcements and unverified allegations.

benefits.zh: 增加句子組織方式 你可以先交代時間、來源或背景，再提出主要消息。 Yesterday, it was announced that the school would reopen. According to the report, it is believed that the damage is limited. Although the investigation is continuing, it is reported that no evidence has been found. 這樣能避免所有句子都使用相同開頭。
benefits.en: It provides more ways to organise a sentence by allowing time, source or background information to come first.

benefits.zh: 把個人說法改為較中立的報道 Compare: The company claims that the product is completely safe. In a company statement, it is claimed that the product is completely safe. 第二句仍然表明消息來自公司，但句子結構把焦點放在公司的說法，而不是公司本身。
benefits.en: It can turn a personal statement into a more neutral report while still identifying the source when necessary.
